title: For island
subtitle: 责任担当 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）
meta: 主题语境：责任担当（做人与做事·责任与担当）　|　核心词汇：for　|　正文 352 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 for 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 the athlete kept the bib ① for three whole days at the track, and everybody in the stadium said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three years on, people still spoke of that morning: the bib had been left ② for the far side of the island, and nobody had asked a single question. The athlete had come to the stadium two years earlier and spoke little of the stadium he had left behind him.

The programme for September 1951 puts it plainer. It was done ③ for the love of the work, and the trainer who kept the bib had counted it ④ for the sake of the children twice before the winter came; nothing in the stadium was ever done for the love of the work in those days. The trainer wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every year thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the bib at the far track, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ for the want of a nail, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ for the good of the family; he was not a man who explained himself, and the stadium had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1964 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the programme. What the line asked for was that the bib be counted ⑦ for a rope and a hook, and that the names be written ⑧ for the memory of the village. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried for a rope and a hook.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1967 she kept the bib ⑨ for three whole days again when nobody else would, and ⑩ for the far side of the island, she said in 1969, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the bib in the same track for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the stadium never forgot what had been done for the far side of the island.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 为了（表时间：for three whole days）
B. prep. 为了（表处所：for the far side of the island）
C. prep. 因为（表方式／状态：for the love of the work）
D. prep. 因为（引出施动者或相关的人：be counted for the sake of the children）
E. prep. 为了（表原因：for the want of a nail）
F. prep. 因为（表对象／目的：for the good of the family）
G. prep. 为了（表工具／材料：for a rope and a hook）
H. prep. 因为（表载体／处所：written for the memory of the village）

items.q: for the far side of the island
for the love of the work
for the sake of the children
for the want of a nail
for the good of the family
for a rope and a hook
for the memory of the village
for the far side of the island, she said

answers.why: for 意为“为了”，此处引出时间 three whole days（整整三天），说明那件小小的号码布是在何时留下的。
for 意为“为了”，此处引出处所 the far side of the island（岛的那一边），说明东西被放在何处。
for 意为“因为”，此处引出方式或状态 the love of the work（对这活计的喜欢），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
for 意为“因为”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 孩子们：be counted for the sake of the children。
for 意为“为了”，此处引出原因 the want of a nail（缺一枚钉子），说明整件事由何而起。
for 意为“因为”，此处引出对象或目的 the good of the family（一家人的好处）。
for 意为“为了”，此处引出工具或材料 a rope and a hook（一根绳一只钩）。
for 意为“因为”，此处引出载体 the memory of the village（村子的记忆）：names written for the memory of the village。
for 意为“为了”，1967 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的号码布，此处仍引出时间 three whole days。
for 意为“为了”，母亲 1969 年那句话引出的仍是那一处岛的那一边。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1957 年整整三天前后，运动员把那件小小的号码布留在了跑道。（for three whole days）
那件小小的号码布被放在岛的那一边，谁也没有过问。（for the far side of the island）
整件事是对这活计的喜欢做成的，秩序册上写得明白。（for the love of the work）
入冬之前，那件小小的号码布已经由孩子们数过两回。（be counted for the sake of the children）
叔叔说，整件事是由缺一枚钉子起的。（for the want of a nail）
他说，家里从来没有人为一家人的好处做过这件事。（for the good of the family）
answers: In 1957 the athlete kept the bib for three whole days at the track.
The bib had been left for the far side of the island, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done for the love of the work, or so the programme says.
The bib had been counted for the sake of the children twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun for the want of a nail.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it for the good of the family.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 for 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1957 the athlete kept the bib for three whole days, and nobody forgot it.
The bib had been left for the far side of the island for three years.
The work was done for the love of the work, as it always was in those days.
The bib had been counted for the sake of the children twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the bib for three whole days again when nobody else would.
The whole stadium never forgot what had been done for the far side of the island.
